robinsonBleedMechanism: The fix is inherent to the whole-county overwrite semantics: any McLennan parcel whose centroid falls inside a Robinson zoning polygon gets UPDATE'd to zoning_jurisdiction=robinson-tx regardless of its prior waco-tx stamp (same feature_index-keyed UPDATE the Waco run used). This will NOT fix a parcel that is genuinely inside Robinson's political limits but outside every polygon in Robinson's own 6,340-feature layer (a coverage gap in Robinson's own source, not a bleed this card's mechanism can close) -- any such residual will be named as an open item, not silently reported fixed. No city-limits polygon table exists in this database to test that case independently (confirmed by table search in CP1); the only test available is: still-waco-tx after the Robinson run, cross-checked by eye against Robinson's layer bounding extent.
